answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A copper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the beacon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
